comments.author: Holfina
comments.body: The outskirts of Famagusta is a really good place to level this skill early on. There is only grass and berries offered there. Bring Traveller's Food Procuring book and you can also quickly level Storage skill at the same time.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: This skill will work even during severe storms at sea, unlike fishing. It also can be used to gather water during snowing and blizzard conditions up in the Baltic Sea, and which will probably occur in the Arctic Seas when we get to Gran Atlas, too.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Unlisted Foot items:

Adventurer's shoes -- +1 Procurement, Adventure-job class restriction, plus 3k fame to equip. More details (including how to get a pair) on the linked article page.

Also...

Hunter's Boots
50 Durability
8 Defense
+1 Procurement
6k fame to equip

Found this at The Rocky Mountains (inland from Tacoma Outskirts) with R15 Search at a Pointed Boulder landmark near the entrance. It's likely they can be dug up with less Search, though, and may also be located at other landmarks. Probably easier to get compared to the Adventurer's shoes by comparison, though nowhere near as stylish.
